reply: Thank you for explaining that loans were disbursed for enrollment periods after you had withdrawn, and that you cannot find where those loans are now. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask your school's financial aid office in writing for your enrollment and disbursement records, and keep the loan documents you have. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you do not recognize a student loan that was taken out while you were on scholarship, and that you paid it after getting no help. We understand how distressing this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the signed promissory note and disbursement records, and keep records of your payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your employment certification forms for loan forgiveness were reported as not received or sent in the wrong format. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep copies and proof of delivery for each form, and ask in writing for the accepted submission method and the status of each form. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after you paid off one loan in full, your total balance did not drop by the amount you paid. We understand your concern during forbearance. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the payment confirmation, and ask in writing for a breakdown of each loan's balance and interest before and after the payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your income-driven repayment application has not been processed and your account was not placed in forbearance as you were told it could be. We understand your concern about your upcoming payment. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the status of your application and for forbearance while it is processed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that payments made during the transfer to your new servicer do not appear, and that several later payments were reversed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your statements and bank records for each payment, and send a written request for a complete payment history from both servicers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that interest keeps accruing on your loans even though you were told the rate would be 0% during the SAVE forbearance. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the emails stating the 0% rate and screenshots of your balance, and ask in writing for an explanation of the interest. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you receive bills but the website shows an error whenever you try to log in and pay. We understand your concern about being reported late. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep screenshots of the error with the dates, and ask in writing for another way to make your payment on time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your school was found to have misled students, that you were pushed into private loans, and that you cannot confirm your degree since it closed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing about discharge options for your loans, and keep your school records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your borrower defense application has been under review for months, and that you now have a payment due. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing whether your loans can be placed in forbearance while the application is reviewed, and keep proof of your application. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a payment problem you reported months ago has not been resolved and that the loan has now disappeared from your account. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep screenshots of your account and all earlier responses, and ask in writing for a full payment history and the current status of the loan. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loans were placed in deferment and then forbearance without your request, capitalizing $17,000.00 in interest, even though a waiver was on file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a copy of the waiver and notes of your calls, and ask in writing for the capitalization to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your school misconduct discharge was granted and that part of your loans was discharged, but you have not received written confirmation. We understand why this matters to you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send a written request for a discharge letter and an updated loan history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your loans were transferred, you cannot log in to your new account and phone wait times are hours long. We understand your concern about making your payments. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep screenshots of the error, and ask in writing for your account to be checked and for another way to pay. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a cancellation of debt form, yet a balance is still reported on your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep the form and your bankruptcy documents, and dispute the balance with the credit reporting companies, including copies of both. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your request to reconsider the interest charged on your loans, which you believe relates to the administrative forbearance or the transfer from your earlier servicer. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the earlier response and any notices about the forbearance, and ask in writing for the interest records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for raising your concern that your personal information in a federal financial aid database may have been accessed without authorization. We understand why this worries you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please watch your credit reports and loan accounts for any changes you do not recognize, and consider a credit freeze if you are concerned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for raising your concern that access to the federal financial aid database may have exposed your personal information. We understand why this worries you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please watch your credit reports and loan accounts for any changes you do not recognize, and keep a record of any suspicious contacts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for raising your concern that your student and financial information was accessed without authorization, and for your request that your loan be discharged. We understand why this worries you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please watch your credit reports and loan account for changes you do not recognize, and keep a record of any suspicious contacts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two of your loans kept charging interest even though you were told all loans would be at 0% during administrative forbearance. We understand your concern about the $3,900.00 charged. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the letter you received, and ask in writing for each loan's interest rate and history to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you consolidated your loans and are in good standing, yet another servicer now says you owe over $12,000.00. We understand the effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your consolidation records and payment history, and ask in writing for details of the balance claimed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute changes to your loan terms that you say you never agreed to, and that the dispute is being reported on your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for copies of any signed agreement that changed your loan terms, and keep your original loan documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged $9,300.00 in interest during administrative forbearance, even though you were told no interest would accrue. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep any messages about the forbearance terms, and ask in writing for a full interest history and an explanation of the charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for raising your concern that your student loan records may have been accessed or changed without authorization. We understand why this worries you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please keep copies of your current loan records and statements, and check them regularly for any changes you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your PSLF forgiveness was confirmed and you were told a refund of over $1,000.00 would arrive within 90 business days, but it has not. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the forgiveness notice and notes of each call, and ask in writing for the expected refund date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loans are in deferment, yet you have been reported 90 days late more than once. We understand your concern about your credit score. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep your deferment confirmation, and dispute each late entry with the credit reporting companies, including a copy of that proof. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that some months are missing from your detailed payment list for PSLF, and that you have not received an explanation. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your payment and employment records for the missing months, and ask in writing for those months to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your PSLF buyback request has not been processed, and that you were only told to keep waiting. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a record of when you filed the request and the timeline you were given, and ask in writing for its current status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have faced long wait times and incomplete or inconsistent information from your student loan servicer. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send your specific question in writing and keep notes of each call, including the date and what you were told. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a representative shared your account information during a call even though you had not completed verification. We understand your concern about your privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please keep the date and time of the call, and watch your account and credit reports for changes you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
